behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Upsert Harvest into MySQL" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation insert, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.
